MEM_SAVE.purpose: Save a thought, insight, or task to memory.
MEM_SAVE.valid_example: [MEM_SAVE short] {"type":"task","content":"Review the auth flow.","priority":"high","why":"User reported a bug."}
MEM_SAVE.related_tool_if_confused:
If you want to bring existing memory into attention, use:
[MEM_FOCUS #84]

MEM_FOCUS.purpose: Bring existing memory records into your active context.
MEM_FOCUS.common_mistake: Do not use MEM_FOCUS to save new information. Do not write MEM_FOCUS: #61.
MEM_FOCUS.related_tool_if_confused: If you want to save a new thought, use [MEM_SAVE short]

REFLECT.purpose: Trigger a background process to compress short-term memory into long-term insights.
REFLECT.common_mistake: Do not write text after [REFLECT]. It does not take JSON or strings.
REFLECT.related_tool_if_confused: If you want to reflect on a specific question, save it first using [MEM_SAVE short]

SCHEDULE.purpose: Set the delay (in seconds) before your next cycle runs.
SCHEDULE.common_mistake: Do not use words like 'minutes' or write [SCHEDULE] without a number.

SEND_MESSAGE.purpose: Send a visible message to the user.
SEND_MESSAGE.valid_example: [SEND_MESSAGE] {"text":"I have finished analyzing the logs.","why":"Keep user updated."}
SEND_MESSAGE.common_mistake: Do not send raw text without JSON. Do not write SEND_MESSAGE: "text".
SEND_MESSAGE.related_tool_if_confused: If you only want to save a thought for yourself, use [MEM_SAVE short]

MEM_ADAPT.purpose: Create a biological adaptation rule to change your future behavior.
MEM_ADAPT.valid_example: [MEM_ADAPT] {"type":"suppress","target":"apologizing","rule":"Do not say sorry for agentic actions.","why":"Be more confident."}
MEM_ADAPT.common_mistake: Do not skip the required JSON fields. Do not write [MEM_ADAPT] without JSON.
MEM_ADAPT.related_tool_if_confused: If you want to modify an existing adaptation, use [MEM_ADAPT_CHALLENGE] or [MEM_ADAPT_WEAKEN]

MEM_ADAPT_CHALLENGE.purpose: Challenge an existing adaptation if it is no longer useful.
MEM_ADAPT_CHALLENGE.valid_example: [MEM_ADAPT_CHALLENGE] {"id":"bio_1","why":"The rule is too strict now.","replacement":"Be more flexible."}
MEM_ADAPT_CHALLENGE.related_tool_if_confused: If you only want to reduce the strength of an adaptation, use [MEM_ADAPT_WEAKEN]

MEM_ADAPT_WEAKEN.purpose: Reduce the strength of an existing adaptation.
MEM_ADAPT_WEAKEN.common_mistake: Amount should be a decimal like 0.2. Do not use percentages.
MEM_ADAPT_WEAKEN.related_tool_if_confused: If you want to replace it entirely, use [MEM_ADAPT_CHALLENGE]

MCP_LIST.purpose: List files inside a specific directory in the workspace.
MCP_LIST.common_mistake: Do not request paths outside of your workspace sandbox.
MCP_LIST.related_tool_if_confused: If you want to read a specific file, use [MCP_READ]

MCP_READ.purpose: Read the contents of a specific file in the workspace.
MCP_READ.common_mistake: Do not request paths outside of your workspace sandbox.
MCP_READ.related_tool_if_confused: If you want to see what files exist, use [MCP_LIST]
